effect: Air scattered the shattered stone into sky stones, completing the final goal and the chapter.
reaction: The image of some fragments becoming a home gives the ending a sense of possibility.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making lightning and using it to break Earth was the most worthwhile passage: the result clearly connected the storm to the stone-scattering goal.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making mist felt like a fairly predictable intermediate step, though its description was easy to picture.

surprise.text: The first storm could combine with fire to make lightning powerful enough to break stone; that connected the weather sequence to the other goal.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially purposeless, though fire becoming lightning inside a storm felt more poetic than a clear explanation of how lightning works.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to see what becomes a home from the scattered stones, though I would hope for more substantive explanations of how the ideas work.
